name: rfutils
description: RF coordination toolkit — scanning, frequency planning and wireless monitoring in one server. Note: Discovers receivers over the LAN, so the template ships host networking. Port is read from RFUTILS_SERVER_PORT (falling back to PORT, then 8420). This container uses host networking because it discovers devices over mDNS/broadcast, which Docker's bridge network does not reliably forward. In bridge mode discovery finds nothing rather than reporting an error.

variables.name: Listen Port
variables.description: Port the server binds to inside the container.
